pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Load a train-mounted inventory, travel to a different station, align the interfaces and let a nonempty stack enter the stationary destination storage.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Place facing Portable Storage Interfaces, one on the contraption and one stationary, with the supported gap. Connect while aligned and transfer through the stationary side to the contraption inventories.
